segments.tha-ap283:2.3: Tassa paṇṇaṃ mayā dinnaṃ, nisinnaṃ [nisinnassa (syā. aṭṭha.)] paṇṇasanthare.
segments.tha-ap283:5.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā paṇṇadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.

lines: 1-2. Ekūnatiṃsatime vagge paṭhamāpadāne paṇṇabhojanabhojanoti khīrapaṇṇādibhojanassa bhuñjanatthāya paṇṇasālāya nisinno amhi bhavāmīti attho.
Upaviṭṭhañca maṃ santanti paṇṇasālāyaṃ upaviṭṭhaṃ santaṃ vijjamānaṃ maṃ.
Lokapajjoto lokapadīpo siddhattho bhagavā upagacchi, mama samīpaṃ agamāsīti attho.
Nisinnassa paṇṇasanthareti upagantvā paṇṇasanthare nisinnassa khādanatthāya seditaṃ paṇṇaṃ mayā dinnanti sambandho.
